messages.message: ### Step 2: Direct Translation Translate each source line into Hindi, guided by the Reference Translation and Step 1 analysis. Output: ONE Hindi line per source line (preserve line count and end punctuation). Rules: - Follow the meaning from Reference Translation. - For "so X that Y": keep resultative structure, do NOT convert to "because". - No internal punctuation; copy only end punctuation from source.
उसने मुझे उत्तर दिया: “न मैं मनुष्य हूँ, मैं पहले मनुष्य था, और मेरे माता‑पिता लोंबार्ड थे, हम दोनों देश के अनुसार मंटुआन हैं।

### Step 3: Word Table & Coverage Check Build a word table from Step 2 translation, mapping each source word to its target equivalent. Output: ONE Markdown table (all lines combined). Mark UNNECESSARY for elements present in source but not needed in target language (e.g., articles that target language omits naturally). After the table, list any MISSING, WRONG, GRAMMAR, or UNNECESSARY items.
